Subject: Customer Chronicle: HealthBridge interview coordination

Hi Marcus / Monica,

Thanks again for the note — we'd be happy to participate in a short customer discussion to highlight how HealthBridge is using Redwood Inference for triage and document summarization.

A few quick details from our side:
- Ideal length: 30 minutes (high-level product story + outcomes)
- Preferred week: Dec 21–23 (we're flexible mornings PT)
- Stakeholders to include: myself (Product), Evelyn Ross (Head of Clinical Ops), and one engineer (TBD)

Two asks before we lock the slot:
1) Can you share the proposed agenda?
2) We need a standard recording/consent form to share with our legal team (they do a quick review).

Thanks — copying Evelyn to loop her in.

Best,
Jorge
Director of Product
HealthBridge

Thanks Jorge — great to hear you can join. A few quick notes and a proposed agenda below. We can tighten to 20 minutes if preferred.

Proposed 30-minute agenda (we'll share a doc):
- 0:00–0:05 Introductions & context (Redwood + HealthBridge attendees)
- 0:05–0:15 Product deep-dive: how HealthBridge uses inference in triage workflows (Evelyn / engineer)
- 0:15–0:25 Outcomes & metrics: latency, cost per inference, accuracy tradeoffs (Jorge)
- 0:25–0:30 Quick wrap + permission to publish a short written customer highlight

Recording/consent: we ask for verbal consent on the call and for customers to sign a short one-page release (I’ll attach a draft). If your legal wants to review, we can provide a DocuSign link or a PDF for redlining.

Availability: I can do Monday Dec 21 at 9:00 AM PT or Tuesday Dec 22 at 10:30 AM PT. Please tell us which works and who will be joining from HealthBridge (names + titles).

I'll also loop in Ben from Customer Success to help with scheduling and the writeup.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
